title: 第461章 聂小灵谢礼第460章 战牛克
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
陈阳身形一闪，瞬间出现在牛克身前，掌心再度凝聚出漆黑灵力鬼手，一把将奄奄一息的牛克抓至半空禁锢住。
紧跟着，他运转吸力神功。
强悍的吞噬之力全开，一下疯狂抽取牛克毕生修炼的修为与灵力。
“啊啊……”牛克遭受极致的痛苦，不停发出阵阵凄厉惨叫，身躯拼命挣扎扭动。
可被鬼手牢牢禁锢，他根本挣脱不开半分。
陈阳面无表情，完全无视他的痛苦与潜在求饶，持续吸纳着他的修为根基，没有丝毫停顿。
牛克浑身剧烈颤抖，惨叫声此起彼伏，身体以肉眼可见的速度快速干瘪、萎缩。
短短片刻，他体内残存的所有灵力尽数被吸干，整个人彻底变成一具皮包骨的干尸，再无半点生机。
陈阳散去灵力鬼手。
干瘪的干尸失去禁锢，直直摔落在地。
现场一片寂静。
全场所有人彻底惊呆，伫立在原地大气都不敢喘，心底满是极致的震撼。
一旁瘫在地上的泰山最先从震撼中反应过来，他忙连滚带爬地起身，吓得转身就拼命逃窜，口中凄厉嘶吼：“你给我们等着！成仙门绝对不会放过你的！”
陈阳嘴角勾起一抹冷哼，心念一动，半空再度凝聚出鬼手，瞬间爆冲而出，转瞬追上逃窜的泰山，一把将他牢牢抓至半空。
他毫不犹豫，再度催动吸力神功，快速抽取泰山体内的全部修为与灵力。
“啊啊……”泰山发出一阵阵短促痛苦的惨叫，身躯不停颤抖挣扎。
短短数秒之内，他同样被吸干所有修为，躯体干瘪萎缩，化作一具干尸重重摔落在地。
聂小灵和梦遥看着眼前干净利落、杀伐果断的一幕，心头又惊又震，久久无法回神。
尤其是聂小灵，心底积压多年的郁结彻底消散，满是解气。
多年来，聂家一直被牛克步步逼迫、肆意压榨，如今这个困扰聂家多年的巨大隐患，终于被彻底铲除。

杨虎深吸一口气，压下心底的波澜，快步上前，弯腰从牛克的干尸手上取下一枚泛着灵光的储物戒，转身恭敬地递向聂小灵。
聂小灵轻轻摆手，神色认真：“小虎，这枚储物戒是陈少的战利品，理应交给陈少。”
杨虎心底虽有几分不情愿，但也清楚规矩，立刻双手捧着储物戒，恭恭敬敬递到陈阳面前。
陈阳坦然伸手接过储物戒，没有多余动作，直接咬破指尖，挤出一滴血滴落在戒指表面。
一刹，他与这枚储物戒建立起某种灵力连接，心神一动，就清晰探查清楚戒内的所有物品。
戒内空间充裕，堆放着大量丹药、数本高阶武学秘籍，还有不少金银财物和各类珍稀修炼物资，收获格外丰厚。
看着这满满的收获，陈阳眼底闪过一抹亮色，心底满是欣喜。
聂小灵看着陈阳，眼底满是激动。
好一会，她才平复好心绪，忙转头对着一旁待命的杨虎开口吩咐：“小虎，快带人把这两具尸体处理干净，不要留下半点痕迹，免得后续滋生麻烦。”
“明白！”
杨虎立刻沉声应声，不敢耽搁，当即带着随行的人手快步上前，麻利收拾起地面的两具干尸，转身快步走向深山密林深处，妥善处理干净。
过了一会，他们又赶了回来。
content_en:
Chen Yang flashed and appeared in front of Niu Ke. The dark spiritual power once again condensed in his palm, and he grabbed the dying Niu Ke in mid-air and imprisoned him.
Immediately afterwards, he used the suction power.
The powerful devouring power was fully activated, wildly extracting Niu Ke's lifelong cultivation and spiritual power.
"Ahhh..." Niu Ke suffered from extreme pain and kept screaming in agony, his body struggling and twisting desperately.
But he was tightly imprisoned by the ghost's hand, and he couldn't break free at all.
Chen Yang was expressionless, completely ignoring his pain and potential begging for mercy, and continued to absorb the foundation of his cultivation without any pause.
Niu Ke's whole body was shaking violently, screams were coming and going, and his body was rapidly drying up and shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In just a few moments, all the remaining spiritual energy in his body was sucked dry, and his entire body was completely turned into a skinny mummy, without any life left.
Chen Yang dispersed his spiritual power ghost hands.
The shriveled mummy lost its restraint and fell straight to the ground.
There was silence.
Everyone in the audience was completely stunned. They stood there without daring to breathe, and their hearts were filled with the ultimate shock.
Taishan, who was paralyzed on the ground, was the first to react from the shock. He hurriedly rolled to the ground and got up. He was so frightened that he turned around and ran away with all his strength. He screamed miserably: "You wait for us! The Chengxian Sect will never let you go!"
The corner of Chen Yang's mouth curled up with a cold snort. With a thought in his mind, ghost hands formed in mid-air again, and they rushed out in an instant. In an instant, they caught up with the fleeing Taishan and grabbed him firmly into the air.
Without hesitation, he activated the suction power again and quickly extracted all the cultivation and spiritual power from Taishan's body.
"Ahh..." Taishan let out bursts of short painful screams, his body trembling and struggling.
In just a few seconds, he was also drained of all his cultivation, his body shriveled up, and he turned into a mummy and fell heavily to the ground.
Nie Xiaoling and Mengyao looked at the clean and decisive scene in front of them, their hearts were shocked and shocked, and they could not recover for a long time.
Especially Nie Xiaoling, the depression that had been accumulated for many years in his heart completely dissipated, and he was full of relief.
Over the years, the Nie family has been forced and exploited step by step by Niu Ke. Now this huge hidden danger that has plagued the Nie family for many years has finally been completely eradicated.
Yang Hu took a deep breath, suppressed the turmoil in his heart, stepped forward quickly, bent down and took out a storage ring glowing with aura from Niu Ke's mummy hand, turned around and handed it to Nie Xiaoling respectfully.
Nie Xiaoling waved his hand gently, with a serious expression: "Xiaohu, this storage ring is Master Chen's trophy, and it should be given to Master Chen."
Although Yang Hu was a little reluctant in his heart, he also knew the rules. He immediately held the storage ring in both hands and handed it to Chen Yang respectfully.
Chen Yang calmly reached out and took the storage ring. Without any extra movement, he bit his fingertip and squeezed out a drop of blood that fell on the surface of the ring.
In an instant, he established some kind of spiritual connection with the storage ring, and with a movement of his mind, he could clearly detect all the items in the ring.
There is plenty of space in the ring, and there are a large number of pills, several high-level martial arts secret books, a lot of gold and silver property, and various rare training materials. The harvest is particularly rich.
Seeing this full harvest, Chen Yang's eyes flashed with joy, and his heart was full of joy.
Nie Xiaoling looked at Chen Yang, his eyes full of excitement.
After a while, she calmed down and quickly turned to Yang Hu, who was waiting on the side.
"Understood!"
Yang Hu immediately responded in a deep voice, not daring to delay. He immediately stepped forward with the accompanying people, quickly picked up the two mummies on the ground, turned around and walked quickly to the depths of the mountains and forests, and disposed of them properly.
After a while, they rushed back.
